title: Template filters
description:
Every built-in filter (`:help dbdash-template-filters`): each row is a template as
written and what it gave.

show.title: text
show.description:
Filters for text: case, padding, trimming, replacing, cutting, wrapping,
counting, indenting, formatting, defaults.

show.title: HTML, URLs, JSON, sizes
show.description:
Filters for markup and data: tags, URL encoding, links, attributes, escaping
(a SQL literal in these templates), JSON, pretty printing, file sizes.

show.title: numbers
show.description:
Filters for numbers: absolute value, conversions (with a base and a default),
rounding, sums, extremes, a random item.

show.title: lists and mappings
show.description:
Filters for lists and mappings: mapping and selecting (by test or attribute),
sorting, grouping, unique items, reversing, batches and slices, first and last,
length, attributes, conversion to a list.
